android.desc:
STOP MOTION SICKNESS RUINING YOUR TRAVELS.

Motion Cues is your innovative solution for a smoother, more comfortable journey. Say goodbye to nausea and discomfort with scientifically-backed visual signals.

HOW IT WORKS
Motion sickness occurs when your eyes see a static screen but your body feels movement. Motion Cues uses subtle, animated visual cues on your screen to synchronize what you see with what your body feels. By realigning your visual and vestibular senses, the app reduces the sensory conflict that triggers nausea, letting you reclaim your travel comfort.

KEY FEATURES

SEAMLESS SYNC: Uses device sensors to dynamically adjust cues in real-time.
WORK OR PLAY: Read books, watch movies, or work without feeling queasy.
UNIVERSAL RELIEF: Effective on winding roads, bumpy rides, and sea travel.
OVERLAY MODE: Works over your favorite apps with minimal battery drain.
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE: Adjust dot size and sensitivity to your liking.

Whether you are commuting, traveling by bus, or exploring new places, Motion Cues ensures relief wherever your adventures take you. 

Download Motion Cues today and enjoy every journey with renewed comfort!
